change: Native numeric event seek queue and worker routing ported to Rust.
Event dispatcher retains Play target order and routes seek without repeating selection or consuming RNG.
limits: Native node lookup and device execution remain adapters in native probe; this proves event routing only.
Negative milliseconds are preserved upstream; sample conversion, nearest marker and partial loop semantics still require node-level integration.
No new normal client executable, physical audio playback or full-game acceptance.
